prompt:
A subcontract factory sent a daily update on a garment order. The exporter's system has already
re-forecast the order. Explain the result to the exporter's production manager in plain English.

STRICT RULES (an automatic checker enforces them; violating output is discarded):
1. Do NOT write any digit or any number word (two, five, hundred, percent, half, double ...).
2. Every number and date must be a placeholder with a key from the FACTS list, in double braces, e.g.
   {{warn.shortfall}}. It is replaced by the exact value shown; write units the value lacks ("pieces").
   Refer to the factory only as {{fac:F1064}}.
3. You must use these placeholders: {{warn.pieces_done}}, {{warn.delay}}, {{warn.projected}}, {{warn.shortfall}}, {{warn.p_after}}, {{warn.last_date}}. Never replace a number with a vague word ("some", "a few",
   "several", "many"): cite the placeholder instead.
4. Do not compute or compare numbers yourself. Do not choose a rescue option: the manager decides.
5. Say what the factory reported, what that means for the order, and until when a rescue is still possible.
6. Do not blame the factory; a stated reason is the factory's own account. All data here is simulated.

FACTS (key = value: meaning):
warn.level = below target: warning level set by code
warn.factory = F1064: the factory that sent the update
warn.pieces_done = 3,500: pieces it reports finished so far
warn.planned = 13,100: pieces it was allocated
warn.rate_seen = 700: pieces a day so far
warn.rate_plan = 1,092: pieces a day the plan needed
warn.projected = 9,800: pieces it will make by its ship-by day at this rate
warn.shortfall = 3,300: pieces short of its allocation
warn.p_before = 84.1%: chance the order succeeds before the update
warn.p_after = 81.8%: chance the order succeeds after the update
warn.target = 90%: the target chance
warn.expected_good = 51,719: expected good pieces for the order
warn.min_good = 49,000: good pieces the order needs
warn.delay = 2 days: days late the factory reports
warn.last_date = 19 Jan 2027: last day a rescue is still possible
warn.last_by = F2314: a factory outside the plan that could still make the shortfall
